real: We should use a .env file to setup the environment variables for the app. We should create a sample one for those checking it out
prev_agent: Now it is. **README docs are updated and merged** ([PR #38](https://github.com/scottdensmore/antigravity-brain-visualizer/pull/38), `2d22dcb`). To recap the honest before/after: **Before:** the run steps existed (Gemini/Ollama, config table, port, native build) but a fresh clone would have **failed** — Java 25 / mise wasn't mentioned anywhere, and the feature list stopped at Insights. **After — clear "how to run" now covers:** - **Prerequisites** — Java 25 via `mise install`, the `mise exec -- ./gradlew` fallback, and the exact *"requires at least JVM runtime version 25"* error to expect (the gotcha I hit myself at the start). - **Run** — Gemini (default) and local Ollama, with the env-var reference table and port override (these were already good). - **Features** — now includes the Miner, Eval + LLM-judge panel, run history, Prompt Lab, and Insights drill-down. - **Development & Tests** — `./gradlew build`, `npm test`, `npm run e2e` (the three CI suites). So someone cloning the repo can now get from zero to a running app (and to green tests) without tripping over the JDK requirement. That's **22 PRs this session (#17–#38)** — the platform is built, reviewed, tested, and now documented to match. Good place to leave it.
